title: Bali Backyard Anthem
style: Novelty pop-funk with Australiana and Bali street-flavor, syncopated beatbox grooves, handclaps, harmonica pops, and playful gang vocals; verse opens sparse with toy percussion and call-and-response, pre-chorus builds with layered chants and filtered risers, chorus slams in with big stomp-clap hooks and kid voices, bridge strips to beatbox and comedy ad-libs before a final full-family shout. Bright, punchy, cheeky mix with close-mic lead and wide crowd-style backing vocals., bounce, happy, comedy, oi
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey on the mic, happy smart core
Dunedin kiwi, open the door
Michelle on court, pickleball queen
Mishy Mish Mash, sharp and clean
Ruby in the paint, roos in the frame
My art stays with me, say my name
Wez in the game, coach on the roll
English and Spanish, whole crowd गोल? (ole!)
Platt your hair, then swing that sway
Dollar dollar dollar, Bali street food day

[Pre-Chorus]
Can Ruby swim? yeah, watch her go
Wez says quick, and the water knows
B - I got this, da da!
Corey takes the stage, ta da!
Bali friends, sing with me now
We spin this town in a single wow

[Chorus]
Aussie Aussie Aussie
Here aha, here
Local flavours everywhere
Aussie Aussie Aussie (oi oi oi)
Here aha, here
Family loud, we’re right here

[Verse 2]
Ashley the poodle, black puppy flash
Mini black sniffer, quick little dash
Aussie the dog says, where’s Michelle?
Off she goes, and he finds her well
Whats that. SSatt
Back yard investigator
2 dogs with lots of frogs
One little clue, then a bigger roar
Ashler Ashley, where’s Micha?
Off she goes, super dog speed-a

[Pre-Chorus]
What’s that sound by the lemon tree?
Galah talk back and a quokka degree
Roo roo roo, ruby bounce
Wez says hola, whole crowd counts
Bali friends, sing with me now
We spin this town in a single wow

[Chorus]
Aussie Aussie Aussie
Here aha, here
Local flavours everywhere
Aussie Aussie Aussie (oi oi oi)
Here aha, here
Family loud, we’re right here

[Bridge]
What’s da pelican reckon?
Float by the mangroves, second by second
A Rotto quokka, pink and grey
Micha, Wezza, bo bo, aye aye
Mi mini black sniffer poodle
Aussie, Aussie, Aussie
Ha ha ha, let it boogie
Aye aye, sing it with me

[Final Chorus]
Aussie Aussie Aussie
Here aha, here
Local flavours everywhere
Aussie Aussie Aussie (oi oi oi)
Here aha, here
Family loud, we’re right here

Aussie Aussie Aussie
Here aha, here
My art stays with me, I’m right here
